name: Quintorius, Loremaster
clause: {1}{R}{W}, {T}, Sacrifice a Spirit: Choose target card exiled with ~. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'cast-permission', who: ScopeWho, from: 'hand'|'library-top'|'exile'|'graveyard', filter?: Filter, count?: Amount, free?: boolean, altCost?: AbilityCost, mvLE?: Amount, anyColorMana?: boolean, until: 'eot'|'this-turn'|'while-exiled' }
needs.semantics: A duration-scoped permission to cast cards from another zone, optionally free, for an alternative cost, or spending mana as though it were any colour.
needs.clause: You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost. / you may play cards from the top of your library … pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost / You may look at and play those cards for as long as they remain exiled, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color / You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost. / If you control a commander, you may cast ~ without paying its mana cost.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'exile'; target: TargetSpec | Ref; from?: SetZone; until?: 'leaves'; withSource?: true }  — withSource pushes the exiled ids onto source.exiledWith
needs.semantics: Record the cards an effect exiled as 'exiled with' the source — the association the exiled-with Ref and the exiled-with-card target kind already read (cost-alter.ts:476). Only delve, imprint and hideaway populate it now, so a card that exiles in one ability and refers to 'cards exiled with ~' in another cannot be scripted.
needs.clause: At the beginning of your end step, exile target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard. ... Choose target card exiled with ~.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'zone-replace'; what: Ref | TargetSpec; would: 'graveyard' | 'exile' | 'hand' | 'library'; instead: { to: SetZone; pos?: 'top' | 'bottom'; tapped?: boolean }; duration: 'this-turn' | 'while-on-stack' }
needs.semantics: A replacement effect an EFFECT creates for one named object rather than a permanent's static ability: 'If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.' The replacement family has only the static zone-replacement.
needs.clause: If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.

needs.proposedSignature: static { kind: 'replacement', would: { event: 'damage'|'enters'|'zone-change'|'counters'; filter?: Filter; scope?: 'you-control'|'all'|'self'; to?: 'you'|'any' }, instead: Effect[] | 'none' | 'unpreventable', duration?: 'permanent'|'eot' } · effect { op: 'prevent-next-damage', from: 'chosen-source', to: 'you'|Ref, duration: 'eot', then?: Effect[] }
needs.semantics: The generic { would, instead } shape, plus a shield that BINDS the source it prevented and feeds the prevented amount to `that-many` so the redirect half of Deflecting Palm can read it.
needs.clause: Combat damage that would be dealt by creatures you control can't be prevented. / Lands you control enter untapped. / The next time a source of your choice would deal damage to you this turn, prevent that damage. / If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.
